mechanism: Bisphosphonates like risedronate can cause esophageal irritation and ulceration, and concurrent potassium supplementation (especially solid formulations) increases risk of localized GI mucosal damage in the esophagus.
action: Separate administration by at least 30 minutes; ensure risedronate is taken with full glass of water on empty stomach in upright position, and use liquid potassium formulations if possible to minimize contact time with esophageal mucosa.
